reviews.reason: The submitted set already contains a sufficiently established ordered realization. selected.cif parses with 38 fully occupied sites as Hg22I4Br2Cl2O8 in the reported triclinic cell (V = 1019.7997 A^3, Z = 2) and reduces through its exact centering translation to a 19-atom primitive P1 cell (V = 509.8999 A^3) with composition Hg11I2BrClO4; the reported cell, count, occupancies, and ordering are therefore consistent. The refined metric fits 29 isolated reflections with 0.00060 degrees 2theta RMS and 0.00187 degrees maximum error. Independently auditing the instantiated primary CIF, all 227 observed peaks of prominence at least 1 are within 0.04 degrees of a calculated line, with no important unexplained reflection; a fixed-coordinate whole-profile fit over 7-88 degrees gives correlation 0.9953, unweighted Rwp 8.81%, and RMS residual 0.700, versus 87.96% Rwp for background alone, while the trace's 31 isolated integrated/peak-intensity comparisons give correlation 0.9926. Although the fractional coordinates came from a composition-only COD prototype hit rather than an independent map, this direct atomic-intensity agreement validates the instantiated coordinates beyond a prototype-name or peak-position match. Periodic geometry has no overlap (minimum distance 2.087 A), with plausible Hg-O distances of 2.087-2.751 A and short Hg-Hg contacts of 2.614-2.629 A appropriate to the Hg(I) substructure; Hg(II)Hg(I)10O4I2BrCl is charge balanced, and bond-valence assignment recovers one Hg(II) and ten Hg(I) per reduced formula. Finally, the six exact 2-Br/2-Cl assignments on the four parent halogen positions reduce by parent inversion/centering equivalence to three distinct orderings: the centering-preserving primary and the two P-1 superstructure alternatives, all explicitly submitted. No concrete diffraction-compatible incompatible realization remains absent, so another attempt is unlikely to add a materially different viable candidate.
